_source: Placement library (3/N). Planet-in-house interpretation, keyed "{Planet}:{house}" (9 grahas x 12 houses = 108). Used by InterpretationService to assemble the kundli reading's per-placement points without the LLM. Payload { text }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=planet-in-house` to fill the other 11 locales.

en.text: Strong sense of self and natural authority — you're here to lead and be seen; just keep pride in check.
Identity is tied to wealth, family standing, and speaking with authority; earnings often come through your own initiative.
A courageous, self-driven communicator; you grow through bold effort and hold your own among siblings and peers.
Inner pride and a strong bond with home and a parent figure; emotional security feeds your sense of self.
Creative, confident, and proud of your intelligence and children; a natural flair for leadership in learning and romance.
You overcome rivals and health setbacks through willpower; disciplined service builds your reputation.
You shine through partnerships but must share the spotlight; seek a confident, respected partner.
Drawn to life's depths and transformation; great resilience and research ability, though your ego meets testing change.
Principled and fortunate, with strong ethics, faith, and a guiding mentor or father; a natural teacher.
Career and public status sit at the center of your identity — strong leadership, authority, and recognition at work.
You achieve your ambitions and gain through influential networks; respected among friends and elders.
A private, reflective relationship with power; growth comes through humility, spirituality, or work behind the scenes.
Sensitive, intuitive, and emotionally expressive; your moods color how you meet the world, and people feel your warmth.
Emotional security comes through family, savings, and comforting routines; a gentle, caring way with words.
A caring, curious communicator; emotionally close to siblings, and you adapt easily to new situations.
Deeply nurturing and home-loving, with a strong bond to your mother; inner peace anchors everything for you.
Warm, romantic, and imaginative; emotionally invested in children, creativity, and matters of the heart.
You process stress through service and routine; tend to your emotional and digestive health, and worry less.
You seek emotional connection in partnership — a caring, popular presence who needs a nurturing relationship.
Emotionally intense and intuitive, with deep feelings and a pull toward life's mysteries; honor your need for security through change.
A hopeful, open-hearted seeker; comforted by beliefs, travel, and learning, often guided by a nurturing mentor.
Your feelings and the public are tied to your career; you rise through work that serves or cares for people.
Emotionally fulfilled through friendships and community; your warmth attracts a supportive social circle.
A rich inner and dream life; you find peace in solitude, spirituality, or foreign places — protect your rest.
Bold, energetic, and competitive — a natural go-getter; channel the drive so it builds rather than burns.
You earn through effort and initiative; speak directly, and guard family finances against impulsive spending.
Courageous and determined, excellent with hands-on skills and standing up for yourself; dynamic with siblings.
Plenty of drive around home and property; protect your peace and watch for tension in domestic life.
Passionate and competitive in romance, sport, and creativity; bold with children and risk-taking — pace yourself.
A formidable fighter of obstacles, rivals, and illness; your energy excels at disciplined daily work.
Passionate, assertive partnerships; choose patience over heat, and a partner who matches your energy.
Intense drive for transformation and research, with strong resilience; channel anger and take care with risk.
An energetic believer and adventurer; you fight for your principles and benefit from bold journeys and learning.
Ambitious and hardworking in career; you push hard for status and excel in action-oriented or leadership roles.
You reach goals through bold effort and gain through dynamic networks; energetic among friends.
Energy works best behind the scenes or abroad; aim your drive at private or spiritual goals and avoid hidden conflicts.
Quick-witted, communicative, and youthful; you think and talk your way through life and love to learn.
A clever earner with a way with words; skilled in business, trade, and managing money intelligently.
An excellent communicator and writer, with sharp skills, curiosity, and easy rapport with siblings and peers.
A thoughtful, studious mind centered on home; you may work from home or deal in property and education.
A bright, creative intellect — quick learning, playful expression, and a clever way with romance and children.
A problem-solver who excels at detailed daily work, analysis, and service; ease the overthinking.
You connect through ideas and conversation; great for business partnerships — choose a sharp, communicative partner.
A research-minded, investigative intellect drawn to secrets and depth; gifted at uncovering what's hidden.
A philosophical, curious mind; you love higher learning, teaching, and exploring ideas and distant places.
You build your career through communication, intellect, and versatility — strong in writing, commerce, or analysis.
You gain through ideas, networks, and clever collaboration; your friendships keep you intellectually alive.
An imaginative, reflective mind; your thinking shines in private, research, spirituality, or work abroad.
Optimistic, wise, and generous; you grow throughout life, and people trust your guidance and good nature.
Fortune and growth in wealth and family; you value knowledge, speak with wisdom, and tend to be well provided for.
Your efforts and communication are lifted by optimism; supportive siblings and growth through courage.
Deep inner contentment, a happy home, and property gains, on a nurturing and principled emotional foundation.
Blessed with creativity, wisdom, and good fortune through children, learning, and romance — a natural teacher.
You grow by overcoming obstacles ethically; good for healing, service, and turning hard work into wisdom.
A fortunate, growth-bringing partnership; you attract a wise, principled partner and benefit from collaboration.
Protective grace through life's transformations, with interest in deeper knowledge and support via shared resources.
Highly fortunate — strong faith, ethics, higher learning, and a guiding mentor; travel and wisdom expand you.
Career growth, respect, and ethical leadership; you're trusted, and advisory or teaching roles suit you well.
Abundant gains and fulfilled wishes through good friends and networks; your generosity returns to you.
Spiritual wealth and growth through letting go; charity, foreign ties, and inner life are deeply rewarding.
Charming, graceful, and well-liked; you value beauty, harmony, and pleasant relationships, and it shows.
You attract wealth and enjoy comforts and good food, with a sweet way with words and a love of beautiful things.
Artistic, sociable communication; harmonious bonds with siblings and a flair for creative self-expression.
A beautiful, harmonious home brings you joy; you're emotionally nourished by comfort, art, and loving surroundings.
Romantic, creative, and playful; love, art, and children bring delight — a naturally charming heart.
You bring grace to daily work and service; tend to your relationships and balance pleasure with healthy routines.
Love and partnership are central and favored; you attract an affectionate partner and thrive in harmony.
Deep, intense bonds and interest in life's mysteries; passion runs strong — value trust through change.
You love wisdom, beauty, and travel; relationships and good fortune often arrive through learning or distant places.
Charm and artistry advance your career; you do well in beauty, the arts, diplomacy, or people-centered work.
Gains and joy through friendships and social networks; you're well-loved, with rewarding connections.
A tender, private love nature; you find beauty in solitude, spirituality, or abroad — guard against escapism.
Serious, disciplined, and self-reliant; success comes later but lasts — patience and maturity are your strengths.
Wealth builds slowly through steady effort; careful with money and measured in speech, you earn what endures.
Disciplined effort and perseverance build real skill; bonds with siblings may ask for patience and responsibility.
Emotional and domestic life mature through responsibility; lasting security arrives once early effort settles.
A serious approach to creativity, romance, and children; rewards in these areas come with patience and care.
Outstanding at disciplined work and overcoming obstacles; you outlast rivals and excel through steady service.
Partnerships are serious and committed; love may mature later into a steady, responsible, lasting bond.
Resilient through life's deepest changes; longevity and strength grow as you meet hardship with patience.
Principled and disciplined in belief; wisdom and fortune are earned gradually through experience and ethics.
A powerful career placement — sustained effort brings lasting authority, status, and respect over time.
Steady, durable gains through persistent effort and reliable, often older friends and networks.
Growth through solitude, discipline, and letting go; spiritual depth and peace come from facing your inner world.
A magnetic, ambitious presence on an unconventional path; channel the hunger for more into something real.
A strong drive for wealth and status; gains can come through unconventional means — keep speech and spending honest.
Bold, ambitious communication and fearless effort; courage and skill can carry you far in new fields.
Restlessness around home and roots, often a pull toward foreign places; seek inner peace amid the striving.
Intense ambition in creativity, romance, or speculation — brilliant but risky, so balance bold ideas with grounding.
Excellent at defeating rivals and obstacles; ambition thrives in competitive or unconventional work.
Unconventional, intense partnerships, often with foreign or very different people; choose clarity over illusion.
Drawn to mysteries, the occult, and sudden change, with powerful research instincts — handle risk and obsession with care.
An unconventional seeker who questions tradition; foreign beliefs, travel, and bold learning expand your world.
Strong worldly ambition and rise in career, often through innovative, foreign, or unconventional paths.
Big gains and fulfilled desires through wide, modern, or international networks; ambition pays among friends.
A pull toward foreign lands, the hidden, and the spiritual; turn restlessness into growth, not escape.
A spiritual, self-questioning nature; you seek meaning beyond image — your real strength is inner, not outer.
A detached relationship with money and family ties; fulfillment comes from values deeper than possessions.
Intuitive, self-effacing courage; you act from instinct and may feel a quiet distance from siblings.
An inward emotional life and a seeker's heart at home; peace comes through spirituality more than possessions.
A mystical, intuitive mind; some detachment around romance or children turns your creativity toward the profound.
A natural healer who dissolves obstacles and illness; service and selflessness come instinctively to you.
A karmic, sometimes detached approach to partnership; relationships teach you to seek connection beyond the surface.
Deeply intuitive about life's mysteries, with a strong pull toward the occult, research, and inner transformation.
An instinctive, unconventional spirituality; you seek truth directly rather than through inherited dogma.
Detachment from status steers you toward meaningful work; purpose matters more than recognition in your career.
Gains come and go without much attachment; your fulfillment is inward more than through networks or desires.
A strongly spiritual placement; liberation, meditation, and letting go come naturally — a soul drawn inward.
